programs.name: Computer Engineering M.Sc.
programs.description: The program qualifies you for a technically-oriented career in computer engineering, focused on the development of hardware and software systems, closely linked to the Faculty's research activities.
programs.sourceQuote:
| Standard period of study  |  4 semesters   |  
| Credit points  | 120  |  
| Program start  |  Summer and winter semester   |  
| Admission  |  Open admission   |  
| Language of instruction  |  German   |

requirements.sourceQuote: a minimum of 20 credit points in the fundamentals of mathematics and natural sciences, a minimum of 18 credit points in electrical engineering or media technology, a minimum of 18 credit points in computer science as well as 18 credit points in computer engineering or information technology.
